parameters.content:
## Create a weekly restaurant specials video

### How it works
Read the menu rows marked for this week and render a vertical reel with a photo, description and price for each dish. A branded booking call to action closes the video for your review.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect Google Sheets to Read menu sheet and select your spreadsheet and tab.
4. Set the restaurant name, handle, address, branding and timings in Config. Replace fallback media with your own dish photos where possible.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Set it to **true** for an editor draft and quote.
6. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Detailed setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/restaurant-weekly-specials.md).

nodes.name: 1. Choose settings and an entry point

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Choose this week’s menu

Headers: Dish, Description, Price, PhotoUrl, ThisWeek. Mark ThisWeek=true for featured dishes. The first five marked rows are used; review any fallback photos before publishing.

## 3. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 4. Choose an optional editor preview

dryRun=true returns an editor draft and credit quote. The default false branch renders and spends Zvid credits; upstream AI services may charge separately.

## 5. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

## 6. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download.
